purpose: Machine-readable 24/24 source-context extraction register for the C2-LT-B13 source-specific deep-read queue. It extracts exact-claim, endpoint, population, mechanism, uncertainty, transfer-boundary, downgrade and model-position fields while keeping local review, independent fresh review, reviewed artifacts, advice uses and model admission blocked.

currentLimitations: Automated route checks record 21 public HTTP 200 routes and 3 PubMed HTTP 403 routes on 2026-07-11; they do not prove source endorsement, currentness, full-text sufficiency or evidence grade.
Rows remain before local source-context review, independent fresh review, Source Card promotion, reviewed artifact generation and any model admission.

No row authorizes endocrine, urogenital, reproductive, gynecologic, pediatric, hearing, speech, vestibular, skin, dermatology, rehabilitation, clinical, individual advice, intervention ranking or calibrated prediction.

sourceAccessNotes: 21 of 24 C2-LT-B13 source URLs returned HTTP 200 during automated public-route checks on 2026-07-11 using a non-authenticated browser-like request.

3 PubMed routes returned HTTP 403 during the same automated check: C2LTB13-EXT-004, C2LTB13-EXT-017 and C2LTB13-EXT-021. These rows require manual/PubMed-aware source-context review before source-card promotion.
HTTP status is recorded only as route availability; local source-context review must still verify source scope, text context, date, publication type, endpoint support and transfer limits.
NIDDK, NICHD, NIDCD, NIAMS, ASHA, NCBI Bookshelf, PMC and PubMed routes are treated as authoritative or primary route candidates, not as automatic model-admissible evidence.
nonClaims: This register does not complete local source-context review, independent fresh review, Source Cards, reviewed artifacts or domain-to-model admission.
This register does not resolve any prior B1-B12 blocked row or modify earlier batch verdicts.
This register does not provide endocrine, urogenital, reproductive, gynecologic, pediatric, hearing, speech, vestibular, skin, dermatology, rehabilitation, clinical, legal or individual advice.
This register does not output individual death dates, intervention rankings, calibrated risk predictions, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, emergency instructions or operational protocols.
This register does not claim that any source proves effective immortality, longevity escape velocity, lifespan extension, personal survival or subject-continuity gain.
